mapper.select: SELECT w.WISHLISTID, TO_CHAR(w.CREATEDAT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATEDAT, w.MEMBERID, p.PRODUCTID, p.CATEGORYID, p.PRODNAME, p.BRAND, p.PRICE, p.DISCRATE, p.THUMBNAIL, p.STATUS FROM WISHLIST w JOIN PRODUCT p ON w.PRODUCTID = p.PRODUCTID WHERE w.MEMBERID = #{memberId} ORDER BY w.WISHLISTID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WISHLIST (WISHLISTID, CREATEDAT, MEMBERID, PRODUCTID) VALUES (wishlistSeq.NEXTVAL, SYSDATE, #{memberId}, #{productId})
